fullDescription: A serene, minimalist design system featuring a soft pastel palette (mint, lavender, peach) and high-end editorial typography. Characterized by oversized border radii (32px), subtle card shadows, and spacious layouts, this style is ideal for lifestyle, board game logging, wellness trackers, or hobbyist social platforms. It utilizes a sophisticated pairing of 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for readability and 'Satoshi' for stylistic emphasis, creating a calm and organized user experience.

structured.summary: A calm, pastel-themed form and activity logging system featuring soft-rounded cards, high-quality iconography, and a distinctive editorial typographic style.

style.description: The style essence is 'Modern Serenity'. It uses a light-gray background (#FAFAFA) contrasted with soft pastel containers (Orange-50, Emerald-50, Lavender-50). Typography relies on 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for UI elements and 'Satoshi' (often italicized and bold) for headers. Spacing is generous, and cards feature a delicate shadow (0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03)) rather than hard borders.
style.prompt: Create a design with a 'Modern Serenity' aesthetic. Background: #FAFAFA. Primary text: #1E293B (Slate-800). Accent Colors: Mint (#F0FDF4/text #166534), Lavender (#F5F3FF/text #5B21B6), and Peach/Orange (#FFF7ED/text #9A3412). Typography: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text (400-600 weight) and 'Satoshi' for headings (700 weight, slightly italicized with -0.025em tracking). Border Radius: 32px for main cards, 24px for secondary elements, and 12px for avatars. Shadows: Use a very soft 'card-shadow' (0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)). Buttons: Primary CTA should be #0F172A (Slate-900) with 32px radius and white text. Iconography: Use Lucide-style line icons, 24px size, usually placed in 48px square containers with rounded corners.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical, single-column scrollable layout optimized for mobile/tablet views, organized into logical sections with clear horizontal separators or spacing.

prompts.prompt: A top-aligned header section. Includes a greeting or title using 'Satoshi' font, size 30px, bold and italic. Below it, a sub-headline in 'Plus Jakarta Sans', size 14px, color #94A3B8 (Slate-400), adding context.

A full-width container with background #FFF7ED (Orange-50), 24px border radius, and 24px internal padding. Includes a leading icon in a white 48px square container (16px radius) and a large text input area with 18px font size, bold weight, using color #7C2D12 (Orange-900).
A 2-column grid with 16px gap. Each cell contains a white card with 24px radius, 16px padding, and a soft shadow. Elements inside: a small icon followed by an input field (14px font size, semi-bold).

A section titled with uppercase, tracking-widest label (12px, Slate-400). Features a horizontal flex container with -32px negative margin for edge-to-edge scrolling. Items are vertical stacks: a 64px avatar with 24px radius and a tiny uppercase label (11px).

Vertical list of result cards. Winner cards use #ECFDF5 (Emerald-50) background with emerald text and a 'Trophy' icon. Regular cards use white. Each card (28px radius) includes an avatar, a text block for name/rank, and a trailing score input box with #F8FAFC background and 14px black font.

A bottom-anchored section. Features a full-width button (Slate-900) with 20px vertical padding, 32px radius, bold Satoshi font, and a trailing arrow icon. Includes a tiny (11px) helper text below the button centered for secondary info.

special_ui_components.description: A compact, rounded input field designed for numeric values within a card context.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a 64px wide input container. Background: White or Slate-50 depending on parent card. Radius: 16px. Border: 1px solid with 10% opacity of the theme color (e.g., Emerald-200/50). Content: A number input (font-weight: 900, 14px) and a tiny 'PTS' label (font-weight: 700, 10px) in a secondary color.

special_ui_components.description: A large, clickable banner for primary user actions.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: #FFF7ED background, 32px radius, 32px padding. Layout: Flexbox justify-between. Left side: 20px bold title with -0.025em tracking and a 14px description with 70% opacity. Right side: A 56px white square container with 16px radius hosting a centered 24px plus icon.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain the 32px border radius for all major section containers to keep the 'soft' look. MUST: Use Satoshi-Italic for the main page header only. MUST: Ensure pastels remain at 50-100 weight in the Tailwind scale for background use to prevent clashing. DO NOT: Use high-contrast borders; rely on background color changes or soft shadows for separation. DO NOT: Use sharp corners anywhere; the minimum radius should be 12px.
